$comment: Known advisories in production dependencies that were reviewed and accepted. Every entry needs a reason and a reviewBy date; after that date `npm run check:audit` fails until it is re-reviewed.

advisories.reason: No fixed release exists. Reached only via sass → chokidar (build-time file watching) and @payloadcms/plugin-cloud-storage → findup-sync → micromatch (module lookup with fixed patterns). No visitor or editor input is ever passed to brace expansion.

Concerns esbuild's development server, which this project never starts. Pulled in by drizzle-kit (used only by `payload migrate:create` on a developer machine); not present in the runtime image's code path.
